title: LIVE CHLOROPHYLL / ALGAL ACTIVITY
source_name: NOAA CoastWatch S-NPP+NOAA-20 VIIRS chlorophyll-a NRT gapfilled Daily (ERDDAP nesdisVHNnoaaSNPPnoaa20NRTchlaGapfilledDaily), fallback SQ Daily (nesdisVHNSQchlaDaily); host fallback NOAA-20 VIIRS chlorophyll Daily on the CoastWatch Central hub (noaacwN20VIIRSchlaDaily, same chlor_a OC3 variable)
log_hint: chlorophyll spans orders of magnitude; the field converts to Carlson TSI 0-100 (TSI = 9.81*ln(chl-a)+30.6) so every TSI unit owns an equal share of the color
what: Chlorophyll-a concentration at the lake surface, a proxy for phytoplankton abundance/biomass, shown on the Carlson Trophic State Index 0-100. NOT a toxin measurement and NOT a harmful-algal-bloom diagnosis.
why_extreme: Carlson TSI trophic scale: oligotrophic blues through mesotrophic yellows and eutrophic oranges, with only hypereutrophic water reaching red-violet/deep-purple.
